phase: Phase C3 - terrestrial reference frame, EOP and station displacements: materiality survey (analysis only, no production change)
written: 2026-10-22, before any C3 number was computed (an API smoke test of the Orekit tide/ITRF calls at one point and four epochs was run to confirm the reference is implementable; those values are not used)
motivation: Production stations are WGS84 geodetic catalogue values turned into fixed ECEF vectors, rotated to J2000 with SPICE's ITRF93 binary PCK. The loaded Earth PCK is earth_2025_250826_2125_predict.bpc, so at the 2027 survey epochs Earth orientation is a NAIF long-term prediction. There is no solid-Earth tide, pole tide, ocean loading or plate motion. The Orekit/GMAT trial (agent-sandbox/orekit-gmat-oracle/REPORT.md) found the station 23-26 cm from Orekit's ITRF 2020 + IERS EOP station at a 2025 epoch (11 cm in range). C3 decides, per term and per observable, which of these terms are material for this project's OD before any production change

baseline.model: the C2-I light-time profile DSN_C2_LIGHT_TIME_MODEL (SSB, Shapiro Sun + Earth, TT, full topocentric station time) with exact-epoch production station providers
baseline.station: the production provider's Earth-relative J2000 station position S(t) = provider state - Earth state; its ECEF vector is Station.r_ecef_m

reference_implementation.orekit: Orekit 13.1.9 in agent-sandbox/orekit-gmat-oracle (orekit-data: IERS finals2000A EOP to 2027-11-23, predictions from MJD 61315; ITRF versions file), run in the sandbox venv; the sandbox script writes studies/phase17/results/phase_c3_station_reference.npz (inputs, outputs, sha256). Positions are taken in GCRF and compared with SPICE J2000 Earth-relative positions, as the Orekit trial did

variants.A: the production ECEF vector read as ITRF 2020, IERS 2010 conventions, full IERS EOP (the modern realization of real DSN coordinates)
variants.B: the same vector read as ITRF 93 through Orekit's Helmert chain, same EOP and conventions
variants.C: A plus Orekit TidalDisplacement (IERS 2010, conventional tide-free coordinates: removePermanentDeformation = false)
variants.POLE: the IERS 2010 pole-tide displacement (eqs. 7.24-7.26 with the 2018 linear secular pole, x = 55.0 + 1.677 (t - 2000) mas, y = 320.5 + 3.460 (t - 2000) mas), polar motion from Orekit's EOP history, computed in the sandbox script

reference_implementation.grid: per cell and station a 60 s grid over the cell's time span (+-600 s); the survey interpolates with a cubic spline; the gate S4 checks the interpolation against direct values

T1_STATION_COORDINATES.what: catalogue geodetic values vs real DSS antenna coordinates
T1_STATION_COORDINATES.decision_fixed_in_advance: CONVENTION_REAL_DATA: real data needs the DSS antenna ITRF coordinates with epoch and velocity; not measured (no real coordinates enter synthetic work)

T2A_ITRF_REALIZATION.what: A - B: interpreting the coordinates as ITRF 2020 rather than ITRF 93

T2B_EOP_AND_PN_MODEL.what: B - S: Orekit ITRF 93 chain with IERS EOP (predicted at 2027) and IERS 2010 precession-nutation vs SPICE's ITRF 93 predict PCK

T5_OCEAN_LOADING.decision_fixed_in_advance: NOT_MEASURED: needs per-station BLQ coefficients from a loading service; carried to the owner as an open input

T6_PLATE_MOTION.what: station velocity between the coordinate epoch and the observation epoch
T6_PLATE_MOTION.decision_fixed_in_advance: CONVENTION_REAL_DATA: needs catalogue velocities and epochs; synthetic stations have neither

T7_EOP_FINAL_VS_PREDICTED.decision_fixed_in_advance: NOT_MEASURABLE at the 2027 epochs (no final EOP exists); T2B carries the difference between two prediction series. For real data, final EOP is required (CONVENTION_REAL_DATA)

propagation: each term is a station position perturbation dr(t) (J2000/GCRF axes, Earth-relative); the survey re-solves every observable exactly with perturbed station providers st'(t) = st(t) + [dr(t), d(dr)/dt] (velocity from the spline derivative), delta-DOR with both stations perturbed
observables: two-way range and counted Doppler (Tc 60 s) on every KP2 row of the 10 cells; delta-DOR on the CANON k0 Goldstone-Canberra rows

gates.S1_spice_station: the production provider's Earth-relative position equals pxform(ITRF93 -> J2000, et) r_ecef within 1e-3 m at 200 epochs per cell (the baseline S is what the survey says it is)
gates.S2_sanity: T2B max |dr| <= 2 m; T3 peak |dr| per station within [0.05, 0.6] m over each arc; T4 max |dr| <= 0.05 m (gross-error screens)
gates.S3_phase_b_informational: T2_TOTAL station magnitudes reported next to the trial's 23-26 cm (different epoch, informational)
gates.S4_interpolation: spline-interpolated dr vs direct reference values at 200 random epochs per cell and station: <= 1e-4 m
gates.S5_reference_record: the reference file's sha256 matches the sandbox print and covers every cell and station

noise_levels.PROJECT: range 5 m, Doppler 1e-4 m/s, delta-DOR 5 nrad
noise_levels.DSN_REALISTIC: range 1 m, Doppler 3e-5 m/s, delta-DOR 5 nrad

od_impact.method: the C2 linear bias mapping (KP2 design, square-root posterior, max |dtheta/sigma| over 6 states and K)

materiality_rule.observable_level: OBSERVABLE_MATERIAL if max |effect| >= 0.1 sigma of the observable at DSN_REALISTIC noise
materiality_rule.od_level: OD_MATERIAL if max |dtheta/sigma| >= 0.1 for some design, noise level and cell
materiality_rule.decision: IMPLEMENT if OBSERVABLE_MATERIAL or OD_MATERIAL, DOCUMENT_ONLY otherwise; fixed-in-advance classes are not overridden
materiality_rule.gate_veto: a failed S1, S2, S4, S5 or S6 makes the affected term C3_INCONCLUSIVE; computed-as-FAIL gates are reported; adjudications go to the owner
materiality_rule.floors: thresholds above were set with the C2-I lesson in mind: the observable evaluation floors (range ~1e-6 m, counted Doppler ~1.1e-9 m/s per value) are far below every 0.1-sigma threshold used here

not_in_scope: troposphere/ionosphere and ramped uplink (C5); DE440 (C4); real DSS coordinates; any production change
